scope: Neutral original adult body foundations and anatomical replacement modules. Clothing, faces/hair, tattoos, wounds and accessories are separate packs. No donor pixels or implementations.

categories.our_structure: 8 body builds x 4 proportion frames; frame derivatives counted separately from base drawings

categories.school_structure: 4 main + 2 waist overlays + 3 chubby + 2 mature body families

categories.note: Natural shape alternatives; neutral standing base, not motion frames.

categories.structure: 4 natural resting proportions x 2 foreskin/coverage forms

categories.note: Separate front/back arm parts are not counted as independent pose designs.

categories.structure: cat, fox, wolf x adult female/male; own original bodies

categories.note: Recolors are never counted as new body drawings.

acceptance: All required categories covered; unique visible shape alternatives rather than filenames.
Reference rendering retained, mature anatomy and whole-body nonsexual pose.
RGBA contours inspected against dark and light backgrounds.
Registered replacement masks and common anchors; supported recipes inspected for gaps and overlap errors; no donor pixels.
Full manifest separates source drawings, proportion derivatives, recolors and combinations.
Pack exported separately from runtime and saves.
parity_claim: Required category/state counts covered. Male frame and pregnancy derivatives are explicitly distinguished from source drawings; quality and arbitrary recipe interoperability are not inferred from counts.
